description: Black to kill the L-shaped white group in the bottom-right. Reduce a liberty, force the extension, then capture.

T3.comment: Atari from the right. White is forced to extend.

T4.comment: Doesn't take a liberty. White lives by playing J4.

S3.comment: Atari from above. White is forced to extend.

S4.comment: Doesn't take a liberty. White lives by extending again at L4.

Q3.comment: Doesn't reduce a liberty. White extends at L3 and gets two liberties - the kill becomes much harder.
